text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehe. I accidentally stayed up late watching a music show.
Watching it live is way better than recording it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, for the sake of Umadol research,
a little bit is totally fine, right~...☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite what she said, Smart Falcon seemed to be lacking sleep...
